coverage_notes: OCHA OPT and WHO were checked first, followed by exactly 12 additional targeted searches across Reuters, AP, WAFA, UN News, WFP, UNICEF, ICRC, health/medical evacuation/fuel, crossings, ceasefire/hostages, displacement/infrastructure, and humanitarian transport. No new qualifying development was verified within the strict window. UN News retrieval was blocked by robots.txt; useful coverage remained, so status is DEGRADED rather than FAILED. Direct WAFA source-page inspection surfaced a Gaza casualty item published at 22:28 Palestine time (12:28 PDT), before the prior heartbeat completed at 12:48:26 PDT, so it was excluded as pre-window. AP rolling coverage lacked item-level timestamps sufficient to establish in-window novelty; other same-day material was pre-window or not provably new.
